bio: Treat yourself to Afternoon Tea in the quaint Pendley Manor. The Manor dates back to 1066 and is steeped in history- a perfect setting for a traditional Afternoon Tea.  Afternoon Tea is served in the Peacock Lounge, a bright and airy conservatory overlooking the manicured gardens of Pendley Manor.  Guests can indulge in a range of treats, such as delicate finger sandwiches with traditional fillings and a selection of classic cakes. Why not add a glass of Champagne to make your Afternoon Tea extra special? A Vegan Afternoon Tea menu is also available.  Pendley Manor is located in Hertfordshire, within a 10 minutes walk of Tring Station.
